definitions.explanation: A booth that takes photos, lets you decorate them and prints them as small stickers; also the stickers themselves. Short for プリント{倶楽部|くらぶ} (Print Club), a 1995 product name now used for all such machines.

examples.japanese: プリクラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ゲームセンター→ゲームセンター：27104_geemusentaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧プリクラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took purikura photos with my friends at the game center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}{時代|じだい}→学生時代：31805_gakuseijidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧プリクラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{手帳|てちょう}→手帳：04537_techou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{貼|は}ってある→貼る：10447_haru⟧。
examples.english: The photo stickers from my school days are still stuck in my planner.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- プリクラ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take purikura photos
- プリクラ⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: photo-sticker machine
- プリクラ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧: album for photo stickers

CULTURAL NOTE:
The machines stand in game centers and shopping malls. They smooth skin and enlarge eyes, and let users add drawings and stamps before printing; they are especially popular with teenage girls.
